title: Island map: company town buildings
question: Does island-03 give the buildings the right look, or what should change?

options.label: island-03
options.note: Attached pool changing/shower block, divided onsen, two shop rows around a covered walking street, connected apartments and practical service yards. Corrected coastal access and a visible izakaya frontage. All nine attempts are in the labelled viewer. This remains a planning reference; interior circulation and additional island-place picks still need design. Open points: the pool block looks like offices; the south shop row faces the promenade and has gaps; the red onsen entrance route is unclear; the town still looks clean and cosy.
